_about: Automatic closing rules. Keys starting with _ are comments. Every value here is also the default when your workspace copy leaves a key out. The example is tuned for entry-level machine learning, AI and data roles: change the title, research and content patterns for your own field. Patterns are case-insensitive Python regular expressions.

title._about: Decides which ads get their full text fetched. Wide on purpose: a vague title can hide a good job, and only the body tells.
title._include_stems: Matched with no word boundary, for languages that build compounds (Swedish Dataingenjör, Dataanalytiker).
title._family: A title in your core family passes the content check on its own, even when the ad body is all company prose.
title.family: \bai[- ]?(engineer|developer|utvecklare|specialist|scientist)|\bml\b|machine learning|data (engineer|scien|analy)|analytics engineer|dataanalytiker|data ?ingenj|applied ai|forward deployed|mlops|deep learning|computer vision|agent developer

research._about: PhD, postdoc and research posts are judged on topic, not on title words. Set enabled to false to close them all.
research._method_words: A research title naming only a method (machine learning, AI) also passes to a human read. Leave empty to require a topic.

graduate_programmes._about: Graduate, trainee and early-career programme titles go to the body read whatever their track, except tracks that are plainly another profession.

internships._about: Policy values: all, conversion_or_paid, conversion_only, none. 'where_authorized' applies in countries where your profile says you can already work; 'where_sponsorship_needed' applies elsewhere.

content._about: An ad survives the content check when its body shows ONE signal from your field, or analytics_min different analytics words, or its title matches title.family. Set analytics_min to 0 to switch the analytics rescue off.
content.signals: (machine learning|deep learning|neural network|data scien|pytorch|tensorflow|scikit|signal processing|time.series|sensor fusion|computer vision|predictive model|image analysis|statistical model|data pipeline|data engineer|maskininlärning|mlops|feature engineering|\bllms?\b|large language model|generative ai|generativ ai|\bgenai\b|\brag\b|retrieval.augmented|agentic|ai agents?|langchain|langgraph|fine.tun|embeddings?|vector (database|store|search)|\bnlp\b|natural language processing|transformer model|språkmodell|neurala n(a|ä)tverk|djupinl(a|ä)rning|datorseende|bildanalys|bildbehandling|signalbehandling|tidsserie|sensordata|prediktiva? modell|maskinl(a|ä)rning)

years._about: Ads that ask for MORE than this many years are closed. Bars of 1-2 years usually bend; 3+ rarely do.

languages._about: Languages you cannot work in. An ad closes only when it REQUIRES one of them; the language an ad is written in, or 'X is a plus', does not close it. Known: swedish, german, danish, norwegian, finnish, dutch, french (french is the least tested).
languages._knowledge_is_enough: Languages you read but do not speak: 'knowledge of Swedish' stays open, 'fluent' or 'speak Swedish' closes.

other._close_senior_prose: Closes ads that say 'extensive experience', 'seasoned' and similar without a number. The reason says so, so you can re-open them.
other._close_clearance_or_citizenship: Set false if you hold the citizenship or clearance these ads ask for.
